scope: Target-path reads in the four current build scripts and source lines matching six or more comma-separated hexadecimal DB/DW values.
build_findings: The three component scripts read target files for comparison after producing their outputs.
BIOS construction concatenates the freshly built MSLOAD and BIOS outputs; DOS STRIPZ and COMMAND RELOC process newly linked outputs.
other_known_issue: cmd/command/stub.asm emits the documented three-byte target-derived tail; historical source ownership remains unresolved.
limitations: This is not a proof that every short raw-byte sequence or every possible source transformation has legitimate historical provenance; it is a bounded screening check.
